messages:
sam: quick check — streaming responses from the Node/TS SDK are hanging in our Vite/Next edge build. Locally with Node 20 the stream emits fine, but deployed to the Edge runtime it sends the first chunk then stalls. using @redwood/inference v0.12.3 (esm entry).

julia: which build pipeline? vite config + next adapter? any minify step?

sam: vite 4.3 + next 14 edge runtime. no terser/minify. import in code: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'` and then `client.stream(...)`. stack shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'enqueue') at StreamWriter.write` — looks like ReadableStream gets messed up.

liam: two quick ideas: 1) bundler might be rewriting or removing globalThis properties (ReadableStream/KV). 2) ESM vs CJS entrypoint confusion — if bundler pulls a cjs compat wrapper it can break streaming helpers.

sam: that matches what I suspected. any config people commonly use to avoid prebundling/transform?

julia: try `ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference']` in next/vite config so it doesn't prebundle the package. also check `optimizeDeps.exclude` for vite. prebundling can change runtime globals.

liam: also try forcing the runtime to preserve `globalThis` — e.g. add a tiny polyfill at the top: `if (!globalThis.ReadableStream) globalThis.ReadableStream = (await import('web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill')).ReadableStream` — not ideal, but good for staging repros. Another thing: make sure package.json `exports` points cleanly to ESM entry (`"./dist/index.mjs"`) so bundlers don't choose a CJS fallback.

sam: ok I tried `ssr.noExternal` and deployed to staging. streaming started delivering chunks again. the polyfill wasn't needed after that. I'll open a short PR to add a troubleshooting note to the SDK docs.

julia: nice! can you include the minimal vite/next example snippet and mention `ssr.noExternal` + `optimizeDeps.exclude`? saves future debugging.

sam: will do. also adding a comment about package.json exports so packagers pick the ESM build.

devex-bot: internal doc: https://redwood.internal/devex/edge-streaming-troubleshoot — suggests `ssr.noExternal` + `optimizeDeps.exclude` + export check. :book:

liam: thanks for the triage. if you run into edge cases where CJS is unavoidable, ping me — we can add a CJS-compatible fallback runtime that keeps streaming semantics. :+1:
